attributes.board_name: Missouri State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts

rules.alternatives: The statutory definition of a physician assistant requires active certification by the NCCPA, so NCCPA certification (and its CME) must be maintained. No state hour count confirmed.
rules.notes: Board PA rules (20 CSR 2150-7) on sos.mo.gov were blocked (Cloudflare) and not read, so any CE or renewal-cycle detail in them is unconfirmed. RSMo 334.738 says a license is valid for two years.
